youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for the prayer that hasn't been answered yet.

He: Jesus... I've prayed the same prayer for two years. Still nothing. 😔
He: Every night. Same words. I'm starting to wonder if they're even reaching You.
Jesus: They reached Me the first night. And every night since. Nothing you prayed was lost.
He: Then why does heaven feel quiet? Other people get answers in weeks.
Jesus: Quiet isn't silence. Some answers grow slow because what they're becoming is bigger than the ask.
Jesus: I'm not late. Stay in the waiting with Me. I'm good to those who seek Me.

“The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.”
Lamentations 3:25 (KJV)
